description: O*NET-SOC-aligned fine-grained occupation taxonomy for Blog benchmark (120 classes)

classes.label: Software Developer
classes.scope: Designs and develops application or systems software; excludes web-only front-end specialists.

classes.label: Web Developer
classes.scope: Builds and maintains websites and web applications.

classes.label: Database Administrator
classes.scope: Administers database systems, backups, and performance tuning.

classes.label: Network Administrator
classes.scope: Manages computer networks, servers, and infrastructure.

classes.label: IT Support Specialist
classes.scope: Provides technical support to end users and troubleshoots hardware/software.

classes.label: Systems Analyst
classes.scope: Analyzes business requirements and designs IT solutions.

classes.label: Data Scientist
classes.scope: Builds statistical or ML models from data; distinct from generic analyst.

classes.label: Cybersecurity Analyst
classes.scope: Protects systems and networks; monitors security threats.

classes.label: Computer Programmer
classes.scope: Writes code per specifications; may overlap developer but emphasizes coding tasks.

classes.label: Telecommunications Engineer
classes.scope: Works on telecom networks, VoIP, or related infrastructure.

classes.label: Secondary School Teacher
classes.scope: Teaches middle or high school subjects.

classes.label: University Professor
classes.scope: Tenured or tenure-track faculty at colleges/universities.

classes.label: Graduate Teaching Assistant
classes.scope: Graduate student teaching or assisting courses.

classes.label: School Principal
classes.scope: Administrative head of a K-12 school.

classes.label: Librarian
classes.scope: Manages library collections and information services.

classes.label: ESL Teacher
classes.scope: Teaches English as a second language.

classes.label: Music Teacher
classes.scope: Teaches music in school or private settings.

classes.label: Tutor
classes.scope: Private or supplemental instruction outside formal school employment.

classes.label: Graphic Designer
classes.scope: Creates visual designs for print or digital media.

classes.label: Writer
classes.scope: Professional author, novelist, or creative writer.

classes.label: Journalist
classes.scope: Reports news for newspapers, magazines, or broadcast.

classes.label: Actor
classes.scope: Performs in theater, film, or television.

classes.label: Film Editor
classes.scope: Edits film or video content professionally.

classes.label: Public Relations Specialist
classes.scope: Manages public image and media relations.

classes.label: Media Producer
classes.scope: Produces media content for TV, radio, or online.

classes.label: Broadcast Announcer
classes.scope: Hosts or announces on broadcast media.

classes.label: Paralegal
classes.scope: Assists lawyers with legal research and documents.

classes.label: Financial Analyst
classes.scope: Analyzes financial data for investment or planning.

classes.label: Tax Preparer
classes.scope: Prepares tax returns for individuals or businesses.

classes.label: Biologist
classes.scope: Research or applied work in biological sciences.

classes.label: Civil Engineer
classes.scope: Designs infrastructure such as roads and bridges.

classes.label: Registered Nurse
classes.scope: Provides patient care as licensed nurse.

classes.label: Pharmacist
classes.scope: Dispenses medications and advises on drug use.

classes.label: Social Worker
classes.scope: Assists individuals with social and personal problems.

classes.label: Management Consultant
classes.scope: Advises organizations on business strategy and operations.

classes.label: Human Resources Manager
classes.scope: Manages recruitment, benefits, and employee relations.

classes.label: Project Manager
classes.scope: Plans and coordinates projects across teams.

classes.label: Real Estate Agent
classes.scope: Buys, sells, or rents properties for clients.

classes.label: Receptionist
classes.scope: Greets visitors and manages front desk.

classes.label: Cashier
classes.scope: Processes customer payments at point of sale.

classes.label: Waiter
classes.scope: Serves food and beverages in restaurants.

classes.label: Barista
classes.scope: Prepares coffee and beverages in cafes.

classes.label: Flight Attendant
classes.scope: Ensures passenger safety and comfort on flights.

classes.label: Fundraiser
classes.scope: Raises funds for nonprofit or charitable causes.

classes.label: Urban Planner
classes.scope: Plans land use and community development.

classes.label: Web Designer
classes.scope: Designs website layouts and user interfaces.

classes.label: Research Scientist
classes.scope: Conducts scientific research in academic or industry labs.

classes.label: Graduate Student
classes.scope: Enrolled in graduate program; primary identity is student.

classes.label: Undergraduate Student
classes.scope: Enrolled in undergraduate program; primary identity is student.

classes.label: Retired Professional
classes.scope: Retired from prior profession; references past career.

classes.label: Homemaker
classes.scope: Primary role is managing household; no paid employment.

classes.label: Unemployed
classes.scope: Actively seeking employment; no current occupation.

classes.label: Entrepreneur
classes.scope: Owns or starts a business; self-employed founder.

classes.label: Freelancer
classes.scope: Self-employed across projects without fixed employer.

classes.label: Translator
classes.scope: Translates written or spoken content professionally.

classes.label: Occupation Uncertain
classes.scope: Insufficient or conflicting evidence for a specific occupation.
